summary: Dotclear is a web application designed for publishing and managing a blog. It provides a structured space to author and organise articles on a self-hosted server. As the official details are minimal, it functions broadly like traditional publishing software within the blogging category.
goodFor: It is suited for users who want to run a dedicated blogging platform on their own PHP-compatible infrastructure.
watchOut: Activity on the project appears stagnant, with no recent releases or commit data available to gauge ongoing maintenance. It also faces heavy competition from more widely adopted alternatives.
deployNotes: Since it is built with PHP, you will typically need a web server like Nginx or Apache, a PHP runtime, and a separate database such as MySQL or MariaDB with persistent storage configured.
